sources.title: Admissions privacy notice | Nottingham Trent University
sources.notes: WebFetch returned HTTP 403. Snippet text (site:ntu.ac.uk search): 'Credibility interviews are completed through Enroly and conducted using an artificial intelligence (AI) tool, which generates a score based on responses and forms part of the University's assessment of credibility. The score is reviewed by the Admissions team alongside other relevant information, and it is not used in isolation, with no decisions made solely based on automated processing.' Enroly is the CAS Shield vendor, hence usesCasShield=true. Attribution of this snippet to this exact page is inferred from the result list, not confirmed.

sources.title: Nottingham Trent University: live CAS Shield tenant (ntu.cas-shield.com)
sources.notes: Probed 8 September 2026: the subdomain answers HTTP 200 with the Enroly CAS Shield sign-in page (random subdomains answer nothing), so the university runs its CAS process through Enroly. CAS Shield interviews follow the themes in Brunel's published policy; whether this university switches the interview on for every Nepali applicant is not stated here.
